Why it is the workhorse. Reindexing a connective built from \mathchoice {\textstyle \sum _{}}{\textstyle \sum _{}}{\scriptstyle \sum _{}}{\scriptscriptstyle \sum _{}} or \mathchoice {\textstyle \prod _{}}{\textstyle \prod _{}}{\scriptstyle \prod _{}}{\scriptscriptstyle \prod _{}} is not, on its face, anything: the pushforward is along one map and the reindexing along another. Beck--Chevalley is what lets the reindexing move past the pushforward, converting it into a pushforward along a different map. Every rearrangement of \otimes begins with this step.
